name: nectin cell adhesion molecule 4

function.text: NECTIN4 encodes nectin-4 [Cleaved into: Processed poliovirus receptor-related protein 4]. Annotated molecular activities include receptor ligand activity and cell adhesion mediator activity. It participates in heterophilic cell-cell adhesion and homophilic cell-cell adhesion.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to ectodermal dysplasia-syndactyly syndrome 1 (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; definitive GenCC assertion from G2P. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
